'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Brian Herold LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[It Is The Future You See / Careful Planning|It Is The Future You See / Careful Planning (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Formerly Walter Cronkite
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
